name: Kesh Vatra
seed: To connect prosperous Kettle Crown to neglected freight neighborhoods through useful work.
design: Copper-orange salamander, dark mottled skin, cobalt smith apron, red ceramic wrist guards.
history: A hot-spring grower’s son who became a ceramic engineer and council mediator.
desire: To connect prosperous Kettle Crown to neglected freight neighborhoods through useful work.
contradiction: Believes a clever device can replace a difficult apology.
relationships: Oren is a collaborator; Sori wants seeds; Brakka invokes his town’s neglect; Dreg’s relatives petition him.
arc: Secures a fair freight agreement after acknowledging past decisions and letting affected workers write terms.
story_engine: A forge competition rewards beauty over strength; a miraculous new pipe works brilliantly and has no affordable repair.
writer_truth: The freight diversion helped his first workshop succeed; he is implicated without being its sole author.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
